label: Some reality feature is EXISTENCE_8 at the selected world (extensional real-predicate surrogate)
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation (Descartes' 'existence is a perfection' in Meditation V is navigation, attribution deferred): EXISTENCE_8 holds at the selected world, i.e. some feature of the reality profile is had by exactly the candidates that exist there. This is (an extensional surrogate of 'existence is a real predicate', satisfiable by accidental coextension): it does not say that any concept contains existence, and a feature that merely happens to be had by exactly the existing candidates makes it true.
